sourceBindings.text: First arrange extraction, filtration, reagent reaction and readout. Then tag each of four cards as soil-test unit, product label, teaching-table class or missing evidence. Cards include pH 5.5, P 12 ppm, P 18 ppm and 11-52-0. For each card state the method or crop information still needed; leave X/Y application amounts blank.

units.delivery: Explain calmly and naturally to agricultural vocational learners in clear English. Read only the supplied connected passage with natural pauses. Preserve all negations, conditions, scene-safety restrictions and limits of training. Do not add medical advice, diagnoses, character voices, an introduction, music or an extra summary.
